mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Fireman's Park with a first quarter moon. The space station will be visible tonight starting at 11:10 PM, moving from over Cross Plains toward Oregon and reaching about halfway up the sky. The temperature will drop to an overnight low of 53 degrees, and there is no rain expected.

City news today highlights the VHAT government and public access cable channel. You can watch local government meetings on channels 989 or 1989, or view programs on-demand via the city website and YouTube. Also, please note that residential parking rules require vehicles to be parked on designated surfaces at least five feet from property lines.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Trivia games are taking place today at Hop Haus, Lake Louie, and Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, attend yoga at Insight Wellness, visit the downtown farmer's market, grab pizza at Lake Louie, or test your brain at the Bogey Factory.
In our weekly police report, on July 13th, a driver was arrested for an O-W-I after their vehicle became trapped on a large rock.
Culver's of Verona is serving up the Chocolate Caramel Twist today. They are open until 10:00 PM, which is less than an hour from now, so head over soon to enjoy a bowl.
